model_sql:
select
    o.order_id,
    string_agg(p.product_name, ', ' order by lower(p.product_name), p.product_name) as products
from {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
join {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    on i.order_id = o.order_id
join {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p
    on p.product_id = i.product_id
group by o.order_id

explanation: This procedure builds a summary table with one row per order, listing the names of all products in that order as a single comma-separated string. Product names are sorted alphabetically within each order, ignoring letter case to match SQL Server's default collation. Orders with no line items drop out because the join is inner.
